facts.label: While + past progressive
facts.sub: Use while + was/were + verbo-ing para a ação que estava em andamento, e o passado simples para o evento que aconteceu no meio.

facts.label: Enquanto eu fazia
facts.sub: Use while com o past progressive para a ação que estava acontecendo: While I was sleeping, ... Use was com I, he, she e it. Use were com you, we e they.

facts.label: O que interrompe
facts.sub: Depois da ação longa, ponha o evento curto no passado simples: While I was sleeping, a loud alarm woke me up. O passado simples mostra o que aconteceu no meio da cena.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: While is used for two things happening at the same time.
After while, we usually use the past progressive for the long action.

items.why: We say while I was sleeping.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: While is used for two things happening at the same time. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
After while, we usually use the past progressive for the long action. → Verdadeiro (Yes: while I was sleeping.)
We say “While I slept was”. → Falso (We say while I was sleeping.)

pages.title: A noisy night · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet morning in an apartment in Atlanta. Eva sits on the bed with her eyes half closed. Her pillow is on the floor. Her friend Al brings her a cup of coffee. He sees that she did not sleep well. Al asks about the night.
“Eva, you look tired. What happened last night?” says Al. “While I was sleeping, a loud alarm woke me up.” says Eva. “Really? Was it your phone or the fire alarm?” says Al.

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: Was soa fraco, “uóz”, e were soa “uêr”. Em was sleeping, o was quase vira “uz” e o -ing é claro: “uz-slí-ping”.
pages.how: Diga while I was sleeping como “uáil ai uz slí-ping”.
pages.tip: Compare was sleeping e were waiting: as duas formas ficam fracas, o verbo com -ing é o mais forte.

solo: Modele, peça repetição, depois uso livre.
group: Foco: was e were. Diga while I was sleeping como “uáil ai uz slí-ping”.
Coro, depois um a um; ouça sem corrigir tudo.
extra90: Cada aluno grava um áudio de 10 segundos e compara com o modelo.
